description: productEvents (explicit mode): each case starts an interaction (startInteraction(interaction) under config), then runs steps in order: "span" ends that span through the span processor created with productEvents (its onEnd only; the span already carries rudderstack.interaction_id as onStart would set it), "wrapper_call" calls interaction.recordCall with the call fields plus its window and then recordToolCall(toolCallIds) when it was recorded, "end" ends the interaction (responseText optional), "flush" awaits the span processor's forceFlush. config: captureContent, emitLlmCalls, toolBreakdown and prices go to configure(); the span processor is always created with the in-memory client (ai_otel_span events it exports are not compared); analytics "processor_only" also clears the configure() client (configure({ analytics: null })), otherwise the same client is the configure() client; classifier { intents?, outcomes?, classify: { intent?, outcome?, intent_summary? }, delay_ms? } is configure({ classifier: { classify, intents, outcomes } }) with a classify that returns those fields after delay_ms. Span, event and wrapper-call times are nanoseconds based at 1760000000000000000; drivers add (wall clock in ns taken just before the interaction starts) - 1760000000000000000 to every one of them. expected is every product event in order, without timestamp/messageId, context.wrapperLibrary without name/version, latency_ms, time_to_first_token_ms and classifier_duration_ms replaced by "<number>". Generated by ai-sdk-node test/tracing/product-events-conformance.test.ts.

cases.name: genai_single_call
cases.description: One GenAI chat span: model, tokens, cached tokens, cost, finish reason.

cases.name: genai_agent_with_tool
cases.description: Agent run: two chat spans and one execute_tool span count; the invoke_agent span does not.

cases.name: genai_error_rate_limit
cases.description: A chat span with status ERROR, http.response.status_code 429 and an exception event: rate_limit.

cases.name: genai_error_type_timeout
cases.description: error.type alone (as @opentelemetry/instrumentation-openai sets it) maps to timeout.

cases.name: openinference_cancelled
cases.description: An OpenInference LLM span that failed with an AbortError is a cancelled call.

cases.name: genai_streaming_ttft
cases.description: gen_ai.response.time_to_first_chunk (seconds from the span start) sets time_to_first_token_ms.

cases.name: wrapper_and_span_same_response_id
cases.description: A wrapper call and a span with the same provider response id count once; so does their tool call id.

cases.name: wrapper_then_span_overlapping_without_response_id
cases.description: A span without a response id overlapping an earlier wrapper call of the same provider is that call.

cases.name: span_then_wrapper_overlapping_without_response_id
cases.description: A wrapper outside the instrumentation reports after the span ended: still one call (tagged tracing).

cases.name: sequential_calls_not_merged
cases.description: A wrapper call and a later span of the same provider that do not overlap are two calls.

cases.name: span_after_interaction_end
cases.description: A span that ends after its interaction ended is ignored.

cases.name: unknown_interaction_id
cases.description: A span naming an interaction that is not open in this process is ignored.

cases.name: non_llm_spans_ignored
cases.description: Agent, workflow, embedding, HTTP and chain spans inside the interaction are not model calls; only the chat span counts.

cases.name: content_capture_on
cases.description: With content capture on, response_text is the output text of the last successful LLM-call span (a failed final span still fails the answer).

cases.name: content_capture_off
cases.description: With content capture off, no prompt_text and no response_text.

cases.name: content_capture_end_text_wins
cases.description: Response text passed to end() wins over span output text.

cases.name: emit_llm_calls_on
cases.description: With emitLlmCalls on, every LLM-call span also emits ai_llm_response_received.

cases.name: openllmetry_legacy_request_type
cases.description: Older OpenLLMetry spans: llm.request.type chat, gen_ai.system, prompt/completion tokens, gen_ai.completion.0.*.

cases.name: openinference_llm_and_tool
cases.description: OpenInference LLM span (cache tokens, contents text) and TOOL span; CHAIN parent ignored.

cases.name: tool_breakdown_from_tool_spans
cases.description: toolBreakdown on: tool spans name, time and settle the calls a wrapper counted by id; a failed span is an error; a call with no span stays unknown.

cases.name: client_from_tracing_setup
cases.description: No configure() client: span-built product events go to the client the span processor was given.

cases.name: classification_waits_for_processor_flush
cases.description: The span processor's forceFlush waits for a pending classification, so it is sent before the flush returns.
